mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate, as measured by FEDFUNDS, indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading exceeding 270.0 signals accelerating inflation, prompting central bank rate hikes that compress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases when CPIAUCSL exceeds 270.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low FEDFUNDS (≤0.1%) and high CPIAUCSL (≥270.0) indicates a 'stagflation' environment where monetary policy is ineffective, causing negative equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a housing starts decline below 1500 units signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST < 1500.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth, measured by PAYEMS, indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO reading exceeding 100.5 signals robust industrial production, supporting economic expansion and positive equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 100.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high RSAFS (≥600,000) and low HOUST (<1500) indicates strong consumer spending but weak housing market, signaling demand fragmentation that causes negative equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a FEDFUNDS rate increase above 0.5% signals aggressive policy to curb inflation, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.
